reason: An interface plugin that adds an Archived sidebar panel for browsing, searching, reopening, restoring, reordering, and deleting DeepSeek Harness sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加归档会话面板，用于浏览、搜索、继续聊天、取消归档、排序和删除会话。
summaries.en: Adds an archived-session panel to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI for browsing, searching, continuing, restoring, reordering, and deleting sessions.

capabilities: Lists and groups archived sessions in a sidebar panel
Reopens archived sessions for continued chatting
Unarchives sessions back to their workspaces
Stops sessions and permanently removes their on-disk records after confirmation
Searches session titles, workspaces, and messages
Synchronizes grouping, ordering, and drag-to-reorder state with the native sidebar
